ev_0004.summary: Triangle-like figure with five verified labels: D apex (303.6,65.2), A left (67.6,347.7), O middle (279.4,348.1), C right (570.4,513.0), B bottom-left (197.9,513.1). Eight solid straight segments were detected and each maps to a vertex pair: D-C, B-C (baseline), A-D, O-C, D-O, A-O, A-B, O-B. Endpoints that overshoot their vertex by 1.4 to 7 px were snapped to the labelled vertex as detector noise (A-D at A, B-C/D-C/O-C at C, A-O at A, D-O at O, A-B and O-B at B). No segment extends beyond a vertex by a meaningful amount, so no genuine overhang was kept. detect_right_angle_marker verified no square marks. The one perpendicular junction (A-O horizontal with D-O, at O) has perpendicular edges but no verified mark, so it is recorded only as a candidate and no right_angle object is emitted. No circles were detected. No parallel pairs were supported by the angle data. Two unlabeled points on the baseline (near x=264 and x=295) were returned by bind_point_labels and are treated as non-vertice
